variantInfo.name: Ice warrior
notes: Attacks with slash melee (max hit 6); 100% weakness to fire spells.
Wilderness ice warriors at the Frozen Waste Plateau count for Krystilia's task.

variantInfo.name: Ice warrior
notes: Same stats as the Wilderness variant; found in non-Wilderness dungeons.
These count for Mazchna's starter Ice warriors task but NOT for Krystilia (Wilderness only).

locationComparison.name: Frozen Waste Plateau

Krystilia's task counts only here (or other Wilderness ice warrior spawns).

locationComparison.name: Non-Wilderness ice warriors

taskNotes: SYNTHETIC slayerTargetId 262 (252-305 C2/C3 block): the real SLAYER_TARGET varp for Ice warriors is not wiki-published; QA live-verify.
SHARED family: Krystilia (Wilderness, 100-150) and Mazchna (starter, 40-50) both assign ice warriors; only Wilderness kills count for Krystilia.
Ice warriors have 100% weakness to fire spells; fire spells are fastest, but their low-ish defence also falls to crush melee.
Turael and Spria do NOT assign ice warriors; only Mazchna does among the starter masters.
Frozen Waste Plateau is a Wilderness location; bring risk-appropriate gear and a one-click escape teleport.
recommendedMethod: Cast fire spells (Fire Bolt/Fire Blast) to exploit their 100% fire weakness, or use any strong crush/slash melee weapon such as a Dragon scimitar given their modest defence. Krystilia's task must be done at the Frozen Waste Plateau or another Wilderness spawn with risk-appropriate gear and an escape teleport; Mazchna's task can be done safely in the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon.
